zh: a popular US newspaper comic strip (1934-77), drawn by Al Capp (1909-79). The stories were about hillbillies who lived in Dogpatch, and the main characters were Li'l (Little) Abner, his beautiful girl friend Daisy Mae and his mother Mammy Yokum. The characters were used for a 1956 Broadway musical show and later a film, both called Li'l Abner.
en: a popular US newspaper comic strip (1934-77), drawn by Al Capp (1909-79). The stories were about hillbillies who lived in Dogpatch, and the main characters were Li'l (Little) Abner, his beautiful girl friend Daisy Mae and his mother Mammy Yokum. The characters were used for a 1956 Broadway musical show and later a film, both called Li'l Abner.

zh: （法律上对某事物的）责任，义务
惹麻烦的人（或事）
欠债；负债；债务
en: the state of being legally responsible for something
ex: The company cannot accept liability for any damage caused by natural disasters.
该公司对自然灾害造成的任何损失概不承担责任。

zh: （法律上）负有偿付责任
可能（做某事）
可能受…影响
可能受法律惩处
en: legally responsible for paying the cost of something
ex: You will be liable for any damage caused.
你必须对造成的任何损失负赔偿责任。

zh: （与某人）联络，联系
做联系人；担当联络员
en: to work closely with somebody and exchange information with them
ex: He had to liaise directly with the police while writing the report.
写报告的时候他不得不直接与警方取得联系。

zh: 联络；联系
联络员；联系人
（尤指一方或双方已婚的）私通，通奸
en: a relationship between two organizations or different departments in an organization, involving the exchange of information or ideas
ex: We are hoping to establish better customer liaison.
我们希望与客户建立更好的联系。

zh: 联络人
en: a person whose job is to make sure that there is a good relationship between two groups of people, organizations, etc.
ex: We need to appoint someone to act as press liaison officer.
我们需要任命一个人担任新闻联络官。

zh: a first name for boys
en: a first name for boys

zh: 说谎者；撒谎者
en: a person who tells lies
ex: Shelley wasn’t a very good liar (= did not find it easy to tell lies).
雪莱不是一个很好的骗子（觉得说谎并不容易）。

zh: 解放（全写为 liberation，用于组织名称）
en: used in the names of organizations demanding greater freedom, equal rights, etc. (the abbreviation for ‘liberation’)
ex: women’s lib
妇女解放运动

zh: 自由民主党成员（或支持者）
en: Liberal Democrat
ex: I voted Lib Dem.
我投了自由民主党的票。

zh: of any agreement between the Liberal Party (or Liberal Democrats) and the Labour Party in Britain. The Lib-Lab pact (1977-8) was an agreement between David Steel of the Liberal Party and James Callaghan of the Labour government to work together to oppose the Conservative Party in the House of Commons.
en: of any agreement between the Liberal Party (or Liberal Democrats) and the Labour Party in Britain. The Lib-Lab pact (1977-8) was an agreement between David Steel of the Liberal Party and James Callaghan of the Labour government to work together to oppose the Conservative Party in the House of Commons.
ex: a Lib-Lab deal/agreement/plan
Lib-Lab交易/协议/计划

zh: （旧时供奉神的）奠酒，祭酒
en: (in the past) a gift of wine to a god

zh: （文字）诽谤，中伤
en: the act of printing a statement about somebody that is not true and that gives people a bad opinion of them; the statement that is printed
ex: He sued the newspaper for libel.
他控告那家报社犯有诽谤罪。

zh: 含有诽谤性文字的
en: containing a libel about somebody
ex: a libellous statement
诽谤性的声明

zh: Wladziu Valentino Liberace (1919-87) a US piano player who wore expensive and colourful clothes and performed in a very exaggerated style. He won an Emmy for his popular television show (1952-7) and was a star in Las Vegas for many years. Liberace played and sometimes sang romantic songs and always had candles on his piano. He died from an illness related to AIDS.
en: Wladziu Valentino Liberace (1919-87) a US piano player who wore expensive and colourful clothes and performed in a very exaggerated style. He won an Emmy for his popular television show (1952-7) and was a star in Las Vegas for many years. Liberace played and sometimes sang romantic songs and always had candles on his piano. He died from an illness related to AIDS.

慷慨的；大方的；大量给予的

开明的态度／观点／意见

zh: 文科

慷慨；大方

ex: She is known for the liberality of her views.
她以观点的自由而闻名。

军队向前挺进，解放了那座城市。
